ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Reconnaissance Activity Via GatherNetworkInfo.VBS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the built-in script located in "C:\Windows\System32\gatherNetworkInfo.vbs". Which can be used to gather information about the target machine

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*gatherNetworkInfo\\\.vbs.*"))
